'''Solania''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|tan]]-skinned Human with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a black [[Hair/Legends|goatee]], Solania wore gray [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] or a set of yellow-brown combat armor. Solania wielded a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and spent much of his [[Time/Legends|time]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]], equipping [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] with gear.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Solania first appeared as a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] Gear vendor for Jedi Knights in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. However, with the reorganization of the gear system that accompanied Game Update 2.0, Solania was changed to an Elite Gear vendor, and his armor was changed to a different set of gear.<ref name="TOR" /> He was later removed as a vendor and NPC in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system. Nonetheless, he remains in the game, as the character model is used as part of the background environment in the redesigned fleet areas.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
